room_description: A well-lit bedroom featuring beige patterned wallpaper, a white tufted bed with matching pillows, an elegant armchair, a flat-screen TV mounted on the wall with a modern console below, and a fish tank built into the wall near the door.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the modern bedroom.
Collecting a purple pencil from under the armchair.
Counting the colored fish in the fish tank to get a 4-digit code.
Entering the code '2133' to open the TV console drawer.
Scribbling on the blank notebook page with the pencil to reveal a hidden code.
Entering the code '4325 + 1462' into the laptop.
Matching the colored shapes from the laptop clue onto the TV console dials.
Opening the small wooden box inside the console drawer with the silver key.
Solving the flower puzzle using the battery.
Unlocking the main door using the silver key.

solution_steps: Count the fish by color to find the code: 2 red, 1 yellow, 3 blue, 3 green.
Enter '2133' into the colored digital lock on the white TV console drawer.
Find the pencil under the armchair.
Open the notebook found in the console drawer.
Use the pencil on the blank page to reveal the text '4325 + 1462'.
Calculate the sum of the equation found in the notebook: 4325 + 1462 = 5787.
Enter '5787' into the laptop on the bed.
Note the shapes and colors displayed on the laptop: Red Hexagon, Blue Circle, Green Square, Yellow Triangle.
Adjust the dials on the left console drawer to match this sequence.

final_action: The player uses the silver key found in the console to unlock the bedroom door.
